# Vendored front-end libraries

These files are copied verbatim from their upstream npm packages and must not be
edited by hand. To upgrade, download the new release and replace the file.

| File | Package | Version | License |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `htmx.min.js` | [`htmx.org`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/htmx.org) | 2.0.11 | Zero-Clause BSD |
| `json-enc.js` | [`htmx-ext-json-enc`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/htmx-ext-json-enc) | 2.0.3 | Zero-Clause BSD |

The `json-enc` extension encodes form values as JSON for mutation requests, as
described in [`spec/htmx-migration.md`](../../../../spec/htmx-migration.md).
